Theycrowdedin,standing,They

title: "WelcometoHogwarts,"said
contents: "WelcometoHogwarts,"said,"Welcome to Hogwarts," said Professor McGonagall.

title: "Thestart-of-termbanquetwill
contents:
"Thestart-of-termbanquetwill,"The start-of-term

contents:

title: Youwillhaveclasses
contents:
Youwillhaveclasses,You will have classes with
the rest of your house, sleep in your house dormitory, and spend free

title: "Thefourhousesare
contents:
"Thefourhousesare,"The four houses are called Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, and

title: Eachhousehasits
contents:

contents:

title: Attheendof

91

if you've a ready mind,

107

title: Histurban,hetold

title: Harrywasveryrelieved
contents:

title: Lotsofpeoplehad

title: "Whathavewegot

title: "DoublePotionswiththe

title: Theysayhealways
contents:
Theysayhealways,They say he always favors them -- we'll be able to see

"Wish McGonagall favored us, " said Harry.

title: ProfessorMcGonagallwashead
contents:
ProfessorMcGonagallwashead,Professor McGonagall was head

title: Harryhadgottenused
contents:
Harryhadgottenused,Harry had gotten used to this by now, but

108

title: Hedwighadn'tbroughtHarry
contents: Hedwighadn'tbroughtHarry,Hedwig hadn't brought Harry anything so far.

title: Shesometimesflewin
contents:
Shesometimesflewin,She sometimes flew in to

title: Thismorning,however,she
contents:
Thismorning,however,she,This morning, however, she fluttered

title: Harrytoreitopen
contents: Harrytoreitopen,Harry tore it open at once.

title: Itsaid,ina
contents:
Itsaid,ina,It said, in a very untidy
scrawl:
Dear Harry,
I know you get Friday afternoons off, so would you like to come and have

I want to hear all about your first week.

title: Sendusananswer

Hedwig.

title: HagridHarryborrowedRon's

contents:

title: Atthestart-of-termbanquet,
contents:

title: Bytheendof
contents:

title: Snapedidn'tdislikeHarry
contents: Snapedidn'tdislikeHarry,Snape didn't dislike Harry -- he hated him.

title: Potionslessonstookplace
contents: Potionslessonstookplace,Potions lessons took place down in one of the dungeons.

title: Itwascolderhere
contents:

title: Snape,likeFlitwick,started
contents:
Snape,likeFlitwick,started,Snape, like Flitwick, started the class by taking the roll call, and
like Flitwick, he paused at Harry's name.

title: "Ah,Yes,"hesaid
contents: "Ah,Yes,"hesaid,"Ah, Yes," he said softly, "Harry Potter.

title: Ournew--celebrity."
contents:
Ournew--celebrity.",Our new -- celebrity."
Draco Malfoy and his friends Crabbe and Goyle sniggered behind their
109
hands.

title: Snapefinishedcallingthe
contents: Snapefinishedcallingthe,Snape finished calling the names and looked up at the class.

title: Hiseyeswereblack
contents:

eyes were black like Hagrid's, but they had none of Hagrid's warmth.

contents: Theywerecoldand,They were cold and empty and made you think of dark tunnels.

title: "Youarehereto
contents:
"Youarehereto,"You are here to learn the subtle science and exact art of

contents:
Hespokeinbarely,He spoke in barely more than a whisper, but

contents:
"Asthereislittle,"As there is little foolish wand-waving

Idon'texpectyou,I don't expect you

title: Icanteachyou
contents:
Icanteachyou,I can teach
you how to bottle fame, brew glory, even stopper death -- if you aren't

More silence followed this little speech.

title: HarryandRonexchanged
contents:
HarryandRonexchanged,Harry and Ron exchanged looks
with raised eyebrows.

title: HermioneGrangerwason
contents:
HermioneGrangerwason,Hermione Granger was on the edge of her seat and

title: "WhatwouldIget
contents:
"WhatwouldIget,"What would I get if I added powdered
root of asphodel to an infusion of wormwood?"
Powdered root of what to an infusion of what? Harry glanced at Ron, who

title: "Idon'tknow,sit,"
contents: "Idon'tknow,sit,","I don't know, sit," said Harry.

title: Snape'slipscurledinto
contents: Snape'slipscurledinto,Snape's lips curled into a sneer.

He ignored Hermione's hand.

title: Potter,wherewouldyou

Hermione stretched her hand as high into the air as it would go without

title: Hetriednotto
contents:
Hetriednotto,He tried not to look at Malfoy, Crabbe, and Goyle, who were

title: "Idon'tknow,sit."
contents:
"Idon'tknow,sit.","I don't know, sit." "Thought you wouldn't open a book before coming,
110

contents:

Snape expect him to remember everything in One Thousand Magical Herbs
and Fungi?
Snape was still ignoring Hermione's quivering hand.

title: "Whatisthedifference,
contents:
"Whatisthedifference,,"What is the difference, Potter, between monkshood and wolfsbane?"
At this, Hermione stood up, her hand stretching toward the dungeon

title: "Idon'tknow,"said
contents: "Idon'tknow,"said,"I don't know," said Harry quietly.

title: "IthinkHermionedoes,
contents:
"IthinkHermionedoes,,"I think Hermione does, though, why

A few people laughed; Harry caught Seamus's eye, and Seamus winked.

title: "Sitdown,"hesnapped
contents: "Sitdown,"hesnapped,"Sit down," he snapped at Hermione.

title: "Foryourinformation,Potter,
contents:
"Foryourinformation,Potter,,"For your information, Potter,

title: Abezoarisa
contents:

There was a sudden rummaging for quills and parchment.

title: Overthenoise,Snape

Things didn't improve for the Gryffindors as the Potions lesson

title: Snapeputthemall
contents:
Snapeputthemall,Snape put them all into pairs and set them to mixing up a

title: Hesweptaroundin
contents:
Hesweptaroundin,He swept around in his long black cloak,

title: 111"Idiotboy!"snarled
contents:
111"Idiotboy!"snarled,111

title: "Isupposeyouadded

Neville whimpered as boils started to pop up all over his nose.

contents: "Takehimupto,"Take him up to the hospital wing," Snape spat at Seamus.

contents:

This was so unfair that Harry opened his mouth to argue, but Ron kicked

At five to three they left the castle and made their way across the

113

CHAPTER NINE
THE MIDNIGHT DUEL
Harry had never believed he would meet a boy he hated more than Dudley,

contents:

115

contents:

title: TheycouldhearFilch
contents:

title: "RUN!"Harryyelled,and
contents:

contents:

"We've got to get back to Gryffindor tower," said Ron, "quickly as

"Malfoy tricked you," Hermione said to Harry.

contents:
"Yourealizethat,don't,"You realize that, don't
you? He was never going to meet you -- Filch knew someone was going to
127
be in the trophy room, Malfoy must have tipped him off."

title: "Let'sgo."Itwasn't
contents:
"Let'sgo."Itwasn't,"Let's go."

naughty, you'll get caughty."

title: "It'sforyourown

"Get out of the way," snapped Ron, taking a swipe at Peeves this was a

DOWN THE
CHARMS CORRIDOR"

title: ShegrabbedHarry'swand,
contents:
ShegrabbedHarry'swand,,She grabbed Harry's wand, tapped the

The lock clicked and the door swung open -- they piled through it, shut
128
it quickly, and pressed their ears against it, listening.

contents: "Whichwaydidthey,"Which way did they go, Peeves?" Filch was saying.

title: "Quick,tellme.""Say
contents:
"Quick,tellme.""Say,"Quick, tell me."
"Say 'please."'
"Don't mess with me, Peeves, now where did they go?"
"Shan't say nothing if you don't say please," said Peeves in his

title: "Allright-please.""NOTHING!
contents:
"Allright-please.""NOTHING!,"All right -please."
"NOTHING! Ha haaa! Told you I wouldn't say nothing if you didn't say

title: "Ithinkwe'llbe
contents:
"Ithinkwe'llbe,"I think we'll be okay
-- get off, Neville!" For Neville had been tugging on the sleeve of

title: "What?"Harryturnedaround
contents:
"What?"Harryturnedaround,"What?"
Harry turned around -- and saw, quite clearly, what.

title: Foramoment,he
contents:
Foramoment,he,For a moment, he
was sure he'd walked into a nightmare -- this was too much, on top of
everything that had happened so far.

title: Theyweren'tina
contents: Theyweren'tina,They weren't in a room, as he had supposed.

title: Theforbiddencorridoron
contents:
Theforbiddencorridoron,The
forbidden corridor on the third floor.

title: Andnowtheyknew
contents:
Andnowtheyknew,And now they knew why it was
forbidden.

title: Theywerelookingstraight
contents:
Theywerelookingstraight,They were looking straight into the eyes of a monstrous dog, a dog that

title: Threepairsofrolling,
contents:
Threepairsofrolling,,Three pairs of rolling, mad eyes; three noses, twitching

title: Itwasstandingquite
contents:
Itwasstandingquite,It was standing quite still, all six eyes staring at them, and Harry

sudden appearance had taken it by surprise, but it was quickly getting

title: Harrygropedforthe
contents:
Harrygropedforthe,Harry groped for the doorknob -- between Filch and death, he'd take
Filch.

title: 129Theyfellbackward
contents:
129Theyfellbackward,129
They fell backward -- Harry slammed the door shut, and they ran, they
almost flew, back down the corridor.

title: Filchmusthavehurried
contents:
Filchmusthavehurried,Filch must have hurried off to look
for them somewhere else, because they didn't see him anywhere, but they
hardly cared -- all they wanted to do was put as much space as possible
between them and that monster.

title: Theydidn'tstoprunning
contents:
Theydidn'tstoprunning,They didn't stop running until they
reached the portrait of the Fat Lady on the seventh floor.

title: "Whereonearthhave
contents:
"Whereonearthhave,"Where on earth have you all been?" she asked, looking at their
bathrobes hanging off their shoulders and their flushed, sweaty faces.

title: "Nevermindthat--
contents:
"Nevermindthat--,"Never mind that -- pig snout, pig snout," panted Harry, and the
portrait swung forward.

title: Theyscrambledintothe
contents:
Theyscrambledintothe,They scrambled into the common room and
collapsed, trembling, into armchairs.

title: Itwasawhile
contents: Itwasawhile,It was a while before any of them said anything.

title: Neville,indeed,lookedas
contents:
Neville,indeed,lookedas,Neville, indeed, looked
as if he'd never speak again.

title: "Whatdotheythink
contents:
"Whatdotheythink,"What do they think they're doing, keeping a thing like that locked up
in a school?" said Ron finally.

title: "Ifanydogneeds
contents:
"Ifanydogneeds,"If any dog needs exercise, that one
does."
Hermione had got both her breath and her bad temper back again.

title: "Youdon'tuseyour
contents:
"Youdon'tuseyour,"You
don't use your eyes, any of you, do you?" she snapped.

title: "Didn'tyouseewhat
contents:
"Didn'tyouseewhat,"Didn't you see
what it was standing on.

title: "Iwasn'tlookingat
contents:
"Iwasn'tlookingat,"I wasn't looking at its feet, I was too
busy with its heads."
"No, not the floor.

title: Itwasstandingon
contents: Itwasstandingon,It was standing on a trapdoor.

title: It'sobviouslyguardingsomething."
contents:
It'sobviouslyguardingsomething.",It's obviously
guarding something."
She stood up, glaring at them.

title: Ihopeyou'repleased
contents: Ihopeyou'repleased,I hope you're pleased with yourselves.

title: Wecouldallhave
contents:
Wecouldallhave,We could all have been killed --
or worse, expelled.

title: Now,ifyoudon't
contents:
Now,ifyoudon't,Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to bed."
Ron stared after her, his mouth open.

title: "No,wedon'tmind,"
contents: "No,wedon'tmind,","No, we don't mind," he said.

title: "You'dthinkwedragged
contents:
"You'dthinkwedragged,"You'd think we dragged her along,
wouldn't you.

title: ButHermionehadgiven
contents:
ButHermionehadgiven,But Hermione had given Harry something else to think about as he climbed
130
back into bed.

title: WhathadHagridsaid?
contents:
WhathadHagridsaid?,What had Hagrid said?
Gringotts was the safest place in the world for something you wanted to
hide -- except perhaps Hogwarts.

title: Itlookedasthough
contents:
Itlookedasthough,It looked as though Harry had found out where the grubby littie package
from vault seven hundred and thirteen was.

title: CHAPTERTENHALLOWEENMalfoy
contents:
CHAPTERTENHALLOWEENMalfoy,CHAPTER TEN
HALLOWEEN
Malfoy couldn't believe his eyes when he saw that Harry and Ron were
still at Hogwarts the next day, looking tired but perfectly cheerful.

title: Indeed,bythenext
contents:
Indeed,bythenext,Indeed, by the next morning Harry and Ron thought that meeting the
three-headed dog had been an excellent adventure, and they were quite
keen to have another one.

title: Inthemeantime,Harry
contents:
Inthemeantime,Harry,In the meantime, Harry filled Ron in about the
package that seemed to have been moved from Gringotts to Hogwarts, and
they spent a lot of time wondering what could possibly need such heavy
protection.

title: "It'seitherreallyvaluable
contents: "It'seitherreallyvaluable,"It's either really valuable or really dangerous," said Ron.

title: Butasallthey
contents:
Butasallthey,But as all they knew for sure about the mysterious object was that it
was about two inches long, they didn't have much chance of guessing what
it was without further clues.

title: NeitherNevillenorHermione
contents:
NeitherNevillenorHermione,Neither Neville nor Hermione showed the slightest interest in what lay
underneath the dog and the trapdoor.

title: AllNevillecaredabout
contents:
AllNevillecaredabout,All Neville cared about was never
going near the dog again.

title: Hermionewasnowrefusing
contents:
Hermionewasnowrefusing,Hermione was now refusing to speak to Harry and Ron, but she was such a
bossy know-it-all that they saw this as an added bonus.

title: Alltheyreallywanted
contents:
Alltheyreallywanted,All they really
wanted now was a way of getting back at Malfoy, and to their great
delight, just such a thing arrived in the mail about a week later.

title: Astheowlsflooded
contents:
Astheowlsflooded,As the owls flooded into the Great Hall as usual, everyone's attention
was caught at once by a long, thin package carried by six large screech
owls.

title: Harrywasjustas
contents:
Harrywasjustas,Harry was just as interested as everyone else to see what was in
this large parcel, and was amazed when the owls soared down and dropped
it right in front of him, knocking his bacon to the floor.

title: Theyhadhardlyfluttered
contents:
Theyhadhardlyfluttered,They had
hardly fluttered out of the way when another owl dropped a letter on top
of the parcel.

title: 131Harryrippedopen
contents:
131Harryrippedopen,131
Harry ripped open the letter first, which was lucky, because it said:
DO NOT OPEN THE PARCEL AT THE TABLE.

title: Itcontainsyournew
contents:
Itcontainsyournew,It contains your new Nimbus Two Thousand, but I don't want everybody
knowing you've got a broomstick or they'll all want one.

title: OliverWoodwillmeet
contents:
OliverWoodwillmeet,Oliver Wood
will meet you tonight on the Quidditch field at seven o'clock for your
first training session.

title: ProfessorMcGonagallHarryhad
contents:
ProfessorMcGonagallHarryhad,Professor McGonagall
Harry had difficulty hiding his glee as he handed the note to Ron to
read.

title: "ANimbusTwoThousand!"
contents: "ANimbusTwoThousand!","A Nimbus Two Thousand!" Ron moaned enviously.

title: "I'venevereventouched
contents:
"I'venevereventouched,"I've never even touched
one."
They left the hall quickly, wanting to unwrap the broomstick in private
before their first class, but halfway across the entrance hall they
found the way upstairs barred by Crabbe and Goyle.

title: Malfoyseizedthepackage
contents:
Malfoyseizedthepackage,Malfoy seized the
package from Harry and felt it.

title: "That'sabroomstick,"he
contents:
"That'sabroomstick,"he,"That's a broomstick," he said, throwing it back to Harry with a mixture
of jealousy and spite on his face.

title: "You'llbeinfor
contents:
"You'llbeinfor,"You'll be in for it this time,
Potter, first years aren't allowed them."
Ron couldn't resist it.

title: "It'snotanyold
contents: "It'snotanyold,"It's not any old broomstick," he said, "it's a Nimbus Two Thousand.

title: Whatdidyousay
contents:
Whatdidyousay,What did you say you've got at home, Malfoy, a Comet Two Sixty?" Ron

contents:
"Cometslookflashy,but,"Comets look flashy, but they're not in the same

"What would you know about it, Weasley, you couldn't afford half the

title: "Isupposeyouand
contents:
"Isupposeyouand,"I suppose you and your brothers have to

Before Ron could answer, Professor Flitwick appeared at Malfoy's elbow.

title: 132"Potter'sbeensent
contents:
132"Potter'sbeensent,132

title: "Yes,yes,that'sright,"
contents: "Yes,yes,that'sright,","Yes, yes, that's right," said Professor Flitwick, beaming at Harry.

contents:
"ProfessorMcGonagalltoldme,"Professor McGonagall told me all about the special circumstances,
Potter.

title: Andwhatmodelis
contents:
Andwhatmodelis,And what model is it?"
"A Nimbus Two Thousand, sit," said Harry, fighting not to laugh at the

title: "Andit'sreallythanks
contents:
"Andit'sreallythanks,"And it's really thanks to Malfoy here
that I've got it," he added.

contents:

contents:

Remembrall I wouln't be on the team...."
"So I suppose you think that's a reward for breaking rules?" came an
angry voice from just behind them.

title: Hermionewasstompingup
contents:
Hermionewasstompingup,Hermione was stomping up the stairs,
looking disapprovingly at the package in Harry's hand.

title: "Ithoughtyouweren't
contents: "Ithoughtyouweren't,"I thought you weren't speaking to us?" said Harry.

title: "Yes,don'tstopnow,"
contents:
"Yes,don'tstopnow,","Yes, don't stop now," said Ron, "it's doing us so much good."
Hermione marched away with her nose in the air.

title: Harryhadalot
contents: Harryhadalot,Harry had a lot of trouble keeping his mind on his lessons that day.

title: Itkeptwanderingup
contents:
Itkeptwanderingup,It
kept wandering up to the dormitory where his new broomstick was lying

title: "Wow,"Ronsighed,as

title: Asseveno'clockdrew
contents:

title: Heldneverbeeninside
contents:
Heldneverbeeninside,Held never been inside the stadium
before.

title: Hundredsofseatswere
contents:

contents:

133
of the field were three golden poles with hoops on the end.

contents:
TheyremindedHarryof,They
reminded Harry of the little plastic sticks Muggle
children blew bubbles through, except that they were fifty feet high.

title: Tooeagertofly
contents:

title: Whatafeeling--
contents:

of the goal posts and then sped up and down the field.

title: TheNimbusTwoThousand
contents:
TheNimbusTwoThousand,The Nimbus Two
Thousand turned wherever he wanted at his lightest touch.

title: "Hey,Potter,comedown!'
contents:

Oliver Wood had arrived.

title: fiewascarryinga
contents:
fiewascarryinga,fie was carrying a large wooden crate under his

contents:

He opened the crate.

title: "Now,Quidditchiseasy
contents:
"Now,Quidditchiseasy,"Now, Quidditch is easy enough to understand, even
if it's not too easy to play.

title: Therearesevenplayers
contents: Therearesevenplayers,There are seven players on each side.

title: Threeofthemare
contents:
Threeofthemare,Three of them are called Chasers."
"Three Chasers," Harry repeated, as Wood took out a bright red ball
about the size of a soccer ball.

title: "Thisball'scalledthe

title: "TheChasersthrowthe
contents:
"TheChasersthrowthe,"The Chasers throw the
Quaffle to each other and try and get it through one of the hoops to

title: Tenpointseverytime
contents:

hoops.

title: Followme?""TheChasers
contents:
Followme?""TheChasers,Follow me?"
"The Chasers throw the Quaffle and put it through the hoops to score,"

title: "So--that'ssort
contents:
"So--that'ssort,"So -- that's sort of like basketball on broomsticks with
six hoops, isn't it?"
"What's basketball?" said Wood curiously.

title: "Now,there'sanotherplayer
contents:
"Now,there'sanotherplayer,"Now, there's another player on each side who's called the Keeper -I'm

contents:
Ihavetofly,I have to fly around our hoops and stop the other

134
"Three Chasers, one Keeper," said Harry, who was determined to remember

title: "Andtheyplaywith
contents: "Andtheyplaywith,"And they play with the Quaffle.

title: Sowhatarethey
contents:
Sowhatarethey,So what are
they for?" He pointed at the three balls left inside the box.

contents: "I'llshowyounow,","I'll show you now," said Wood.

title: "Takethis."Hehanded
contents:
"Takethis."Hehanded,"Take this."
He handed Harry a small club, a bit like a short baseball bat.

contents: "I'mgoingtoshow,"I'm going to show you what the Bludgers do," Wood said.

title: "Thesetwoarethe
contents:
"Thesetwoarethe,"These two are
the Bludgers."

contents:

title: Hebentdownand
contents:

Bludgers.

contents:

contents:

"See?"Woodpanted,forcing,"See?" Wood panted, forcing the struggling Bludger back into the crate

contents:

contents:

So--thinkyou've,So
-- think you've got all that?"
"Three Chasers try and score with the Quaffle; the Keeper guards the

title: Now,thelastmember
contents:
Now,thelastmember,Now, the last member of the team is the
135
Seeker.

title: Andyoudon'thave
contents:
Andyoudon'thave,And you don't have to worry about the Quaffle or the

"Don't worry, the Weasleys are more than a match for the Bludgers -- I

Wood reached into the crate and took out the fourth and last ball.

title: ComparedwiththeQuaffle
contents:
ComparedwiththeQuaffle,Compared with the Quaffle and the Bludgers, it was tiny, about the size

title: Itwasbrightgold
contents:

wings.

title: "This,"saidWood,"is
contents:
"This,"saidWood,"is,"This," said Wood, "is the Golden Snitch, and it's the most important

title: It'sveryhardto
contents:
It'sveryhardto,It's very hard to catch because it's so fast and
difficult to see.

title: It'stheSeeker'sjob

contents:

in and out of the Chasers, Beaters, Bludgers, and Quaffle to get it

title: That'swhySeekersget
contents: That'swhySeekersget,That's why Seekers get fouled so much.

title: AgameofQuidditch
contents:
AgameofQuidditch,A game of
Quidditch only ends when the Snitch is caught, so it can go on for ages
-- I think the record is three months, they had to keep bringing on
substitutes so the players could get some sleep.

title: "Well,that'sit--
contents:
"Well,that'sit--,"Well, that's it -- any
questions?"
Harry shook his head.

title: Heunderstoodwhathe
contents:
Heunderstoodwhathe,He understood what he had to do all right, it was
doing it that was going to be the problem.

title: "Wewon'tpracticewith
contents:
"Wewon'tpracticewith,"We won't practice with the Snitch yet," said Wood, carefully shutting
it back inside the crate, "it's too dark, we might lose it.

title: Let'stryyouout
contents:
Let'stryyouout,Let's try
you out with a few of these."
He pulled a bag of ordinary golf balls out of his pocket and a few
minutes later, he and Harry were up in the air, Wood throwing the golf
balls as hard as he could in every direction for Harry to catch.

title: Harrydidn'tmissa
contents: Harrydidn'tmissa,Harry didn't miss a single one, and Wood was delighted.

title: Afterhalfanhour,
contents:
Afterhalfanhour,,After half an
hour, night had really fallen and they couldn't carry on.

title: "ThatQuidditchcup'llhave

title: Hemadehisway
contents: Hemadehisway,He made his way down to the staffroom and knocked.

title: PerhapsSnapehadleft
contents: PerhapsSnapehadleft,Perhaps Snape had left the book in there? It was worth a try.

title: Hepushedthedoor
contents:
Hepushedthedoor,He pushed
the door ajar and peered inside -- and a horrible scene met his eyes.

title: SnapeandFilchwere
contents: SnapeandFilchwere,Snape and Filch were inside, alone.

title: Snapewasholdinghis
contents:
Snapewasholdinghis,Snape was holding his robes above
his knees.

title: Oneofhislegs
contents: Oneofhislegs,One of his legs was bloody and mangled.

title: "Howareyousupposed
contents:
"Howareyousupposed,"How are you supposed to keep your
eyes on all three heads at once?"
Harry tried to shut the door quietly, but --
"POTTER!"
Snape's face was twisted with fury as he dropped his robes quickly to
hide his leg.

title: "Ijustwonderedif
contents:
"Ijustwonderedif,"I just wondered if I could have my book back."
"GET OUT! OUT!"
146
Harry left, before Snape could take any more points from Gryffindor.

title: "Didyougetit?"
contents: "Didyougetit?","Did you get it?" Ron asked as Harry joined them.

title: "What'sthematter?"In
contents:
"What'sthematter?"In,"What's the matter?"
In a low whisper, Harry told them what he'd seen.

title: "Youknowwhatthis
contents: "Youknowwhatthis,"You know what this means?" he finished breathlessly.

title: "Hetriedtoget
contents:
"Hetriedtoget,"He tried to get
past that three-headed dog at Halloween! That's where he was going when
we saw him -- he's after whatever it's guarding! And Id bet my
broomstick he let that troll in, to make a diversion!"
Hermione's eyes were wide.

title: "No--hewouldn't,
contents: "No--hewouldn't,,"No -- he wouldn't, she said.

title: "Iknowhe'snot
contents:
"Iknowhe'snot,"I know he's not very nice, but he
wouldn't try and steal something Dumbledore was keeping safe."
"Honestly, Hermione, you think all teachers are saints or something,"
snapped Ron.

title: Iwouldn'tputanything
contents: Iwouldn'tputanything,I wouldn't put anything past Snape.

title: Butwhat'sheafter?
contents:
Butwhat'sheafter?,But
what's he after? What's that dog guarding?"
Harry went to bed with his head buzzing with the same question.

title: Nevillewassnoringloudly,
contents:
Nevillewassnoringloudly,,Neville
was snoring loudly, but Harry couldn't sleep.

title: Hetriedtoempty
contents:
Hetriedtoempty,He tried to empty his mind
-- he needed to sleep, he had to, he had his first Quidditch match in a
few hours -- but the expression on Snape's face when Harry had seen his
leg wasn't easy to forget.

title: Thenextmorningdawned
contents: Thenextmorningdawned,The next morning dawned very bright and cold.

title: TheGreatHallwas
contents:
TheGreatHallwas,The Great Hall was full of
the delicious smell of fried sausages and the cheer ful chatter of
everyone looking forward to a good Quidditch match.

title: "You'vegottoeat
contents:
"You'vegottoeat,"You've got to eat some breakfast."
"I don't want anything."
"Just a bit of toast," wheedled Hermione.

title: "I'mnothungry."Harry
contents:
"I'mnothungry."Harry,"I'm not hungry."
Harry felt terrible.

title: Inanhour'stime
contents: Inanhour'stime,In an hour's time he'd be walking onto the field.

title: "Harry,youneedyour
contents: "Harry,youneedyour,"Harry, you need your strength," said Seamus Finnigan.

title: "Seekersarealwaysthe
contents:
"Seekersarealwaysthe,"Seekers are
always the ones who get clobbered by the other team."
147
"Thanks, Seamus," said Harry, watching Seamus pile ketchup on his
sausages.

title: Byeleveno'clockthe
contents:
Byeleveno'clockthe,By eleven o'clock the whole school seemed to be out in the stands around
the Quidditch pitch.

title: Theseatsmightbe
contents:
Theseatsmightbe,The seats might be
raised high in the air, but it was still difficult to see what was going
on sometimes.

title: RonandHermionejoined
contents:
RonandHermionejoined,Ron and Hermione joined Neville, Seamus, and Dean the West Ham fan up in
the top row.

title: Asasurprisefor
contents:
Asasurprisefor,As a surprise for Harry, they had painted a large banner on
one of the sheets Scabbers had ruined.

title: ItsaidPotterfor
contents:
ItsaidPotterfor,It said Potter for President, and
Dean, who was good at drawing, had done a large Gryffindor lion
underneath.

title: ThenHermionehadperformed
contents:
ThenHermionehadperformed,Then Hermione had performed a tricky little charm so that
the paint flashed different colors.

title: Meanwhile,inthelocker
contents:
Meanwhile,inthelocker,Meanwhile, in the locker room, Harry and the rest of the team were
changing into their scarlet Quidditch robes (Slytherin would be playing
in green).

title: Woodclearedhisthroat
contents: Woodclearedhisthroat,Wood cleared his throat for silence.

title: "Andwomen,"saidChaser
contents: "Andwomen,"saidChaser,"And women," said Chaser Angelina Johnson.

title: "Thisisit.""The
contents:
"Thisisit.""The,"This is it."
"The big one," said Fred Weasley.

title: "Theonewe'veall
contents: "Theonewe'veall,"The one we've all been waiting for," said George.

title: "WeknowOliver'sspeech
contents:
"WeknowOliver'sspeech,"We know Oliver's speech by heart," Fred told Harry, "we were on the
team last year."
"Shut up, you two," said Wood.

title: "Thisisthebest
contents:
"Thisisthebest,"This is the best team Gryffindor's had
in years.

title: Iknowit."He
contents:
Iknowit."He,I know it."
He glared at them all as if to say, "Or else."
"Right.

title: Goodluck,allof
contents:
Goodluck,allof,Good luck, all of you."
Harry followed Fred and George out of the locker room and, hoping his
148
knees weren't going to give way, walked onto the field to loud cheers.

title: Shestoodinthe
contents:
Shestoodinthe,She stood in the middle of the field waiting
for the two teams, her broom in her hand.

title: "Now,Iwanta
contents:
"Now,Iwanta,"Now, I want a nice fair game, all of you," she said, once they were all
gathered around her.

title: Harrynoticedthatshe
contents:
Harrynoticedthatshe,Harry noticed that she seemed to be speaking
particularly to the Slytherin Captain, Marcus Flint, a sixth year.

title: HarrythoughtFlintlooked
contents:
HarrythoughtFlintlooked,Harry
thought Flint looked as if he had some troll blood in him.

title: Outofthecorner
contents:
Outofthecorner,Out of the
corner of his eye he saw the fluttering banner high above, flashing
Potter for President over the crowd.

title: "Mountyourbrooms,please."
contents:
"Mountyourbrooms,please.","Mount your brooms, please."
Harry clambered onto his Nimbus Two Thousand.

title: MadamHoochgavea
contents: MadamHoochgavea,Madam Hooch gave a loud blast on her silver whistle.

title: Fifteenbroomsroseup,
contents: Fifteenbroomsroseup,,Fifteen brooms rose up, high, high into the air.

title: "AndtheQuaffleis
contents:
"AndtheQuaffleis,"And the
Quaffle is taken immediately by Angelina Johnson of Gryffindor -- what
an excellent Chaser that girl is, and rather attractive, too --"
"JORDAN!"
"Sorry, Professor."
The Weasley twins' friend, Lee Jordan, was doing the commentary for the
match, closely watched by Professor McGonagall.

title: "Andshe'sreallybelting
contents:
"Andshe'sreallybelting,"And she's really belting along up there, a neat pass to Alicia Spinnet,
a good find of Oliver Wood's, last year only a reserve -- back to
Johnson and -- no, the Slytherins have taken the Quaffle, Slytherin
Captain Marcus Flint gains the Quaffle and off he goes -- Flint flying
like an eagle up there -- he's going to sc- no, stopped by an excellent
move by Gryffindor Keeper Wood and the Gryffindors take the Quaffle --
that's Chaser Katie Bell of Gryffindor there, nice dive around Flint,
off up the field and -- OUCH -- that must have hurt, hit in the back of
the head by a Bludger -- Quaffle taken by the Slytherins -- that's
Adrian Pucey speeding off toward the goal posts, but he's blocked by a
second Bludger -- sent his way by Fred or George Weasley, can't tell
which -- nice play by the Gryffindor Beater, anyway, and Johnson back in
possession of the Quaffle, a clear field ahead and off she goes -- she's
really flying -- dodges a speeding Bludger -- the goal posts are ahead
149
-- come on, now, Angelina -- Keeper Bletchley dives -- misses --
GRYFFINDORS SCORE!"
Gryffindor cheers filled the cold air, with howls and moans from the
Slytherins.

title: "Budgeupthere,move
contents:
"Budgeupthere,move,"Budge up there, move along."
"Hagrid!"
Ron and Hermione squeezed together to give Hagrid enough space to join
them.

title: "Binwatchin'fromme
contents:
"Binwatchin'fromme,"Bin watchin' from me hut," said Hagrid, patting a large pair of
binoculars around his neck, "But it isn't the same as bein' in the
crowd.

title: Nosignofthe
contents:
Nosignofthe,No sign of the Snitch yet, eh?"
"Nope," said Ron.

title: "Harryhasn'thadmuch
contents:
"Harryhasn'thadmuch,"Harry hasn't had much to do yet."
"Kept outta trouble, though, that's somethin'," said Hagrid, raising his
binoculars and peering skyward at the speck that was Harry.

title: Wayupabovethem,
contents:
Wayupabovethem,,Way up above them, Harry was gliding over the game, squinting about for
some sign of the Snitch.

title: Thiswaspartof
contents: Thiswaspartof,This was part of his and Wood's game plan.

title: "Keepoutofthe
contents:
"Keepoutofthe,"Keep out of the way until you catch sight of the Snitch," Wood had
said.

title: "Wedon'twantyou
contents:
"Wedon'twantyou,"We don't want you attacked before you have to be."
When Angelina had scored, Harry had done a couple of loop-the-loops to
let off his feelings.

title: Nowhewasback
contents: Nowhewasback,Now he was back to staring around for the Snitch.

title: Oncehecaughtsight
contents:
Oncehecaughtsight,Once he caught sight of a flash of gold, but it was just a reflection
from one of the Weasleys' wristwatches, and once a Bludger decided to
come pelting his way, more like a cannonball than anything, but Harry
dodged it and Fred Weasley came chasing after it.

title: "Allrightthere,Harry?"
contents:
"Allrightthere,Harry?","All right there, Harry?" he had time to yell, as he beat the Bludger
furiously toward Marcus Flint.

title: "Slytherininpossession,"Lee
contents:
"Slytherininpossession,"Lee,"Slytherin in possession," Lee Jordan was saying, "Chaser Pucey ducks
two Bludgers, two Weasleys, and Chaser Bell, and speeds toward the --
wait a moment -- was that the Snitch?"
A murmur ran through the crowd as Adrian Pucey dropped the Quaffle, too
150
busy looking over his shoulder at the flash of gold that had passed his
left ear.

title: Inagreatrush
contents:
Inagreatrush,In a great rush of excitement he dived downward after the
streak of gold.

title: SlytherinSeekerTerenceHiggs
contents: SlytherinSeekerTerenceHiggs,Slytherin Seeker Terence Higgs had seen it, too.

title: Neckandneckthey
contents:
Neckandneckthey,Neck
and neck they hurtled toward the Snitch -all the Chasers seemed to have
forgotten what they were supposed to be doing as they hung in midair to
watch.

title: Harrywasfasterthan
contents:
Harrywasfasterthan,Harry was faster than Higgs -- he could see the little round ball, wings
fluttering, darting up ahead - - he put on an extra spurt of speed --
WHAM! A roar of rage echoed from the Gryffindors below -- Marcus Flint
had blocked Harry on purpose, and Harry's broom spun off course, Harry
holding on for dear life.

title: MadamHoochspokeangrily
contents:
MadamHoochspokeangrily,Madam Hooch spoke angrily to Flint and then ordered a free shot at the
goal posts for Gryffindor.

title: Butinallthe
contents:
Butinallthe,But in all the confusion, of course, the
Golden Snitch had disappeared from sight again.

title: Downinthestands,
contents:
Downinthestands,,Down in the stands, Dean Thomas was yelling, "Send him off, ref! Red
card!"
"What are you talking about, Dean?" said Ron.

title: "Insocceryouget
contents:
"Insocceryouget,"In soccer you get shown the red card
and you're out of the game!"
"But this isn't soccer, Dean," Ron reminded him.

title: Hagrid,however,wason
contents: Hagrid,however,wason,Hagrid, however, was on Dean's side.

title: FlintcouldaknockedHarry
contents:
FlintcouldaknockedHarry,Flint coulda knocked Harry outta the
air."
Lee Jordan was finding it difficult not to take sides.

title: "So--afterthat
contents:
"So--afterthat,"So -- after that obvious and disgusting bit of cheating
"Jordan!" growled Professor McGonagall.

title: 151"Imean,after
contents:
151"Imean,after,151
"I mean, after that open and revolting foul
'Jordan, I'm warning you --"
"All right, all right.

title: Flintnearlykillsthe
contents:
Flintnearlykillsthe,Flint nearly kills the Gryffindor Seeker, which
could happen to anyone, I'm sure, so a penalty to Gryffindor, taken by
Spinner, who puts it away, no trouble, and we continue play, Gryffindor
still in possession."
It was as Harry dodged another Bludger, which went spinning dangerously
past his head, that it happened.

title: Hisbroomgavea
contents:
Hisbroomgavea,His broom gave a sudden, frightening
lurch.

title: Forasplitsecond,
contents: Forasplitsecond,,For a split second, he thought he was going to fall.

title: Hegrippedthebroom
contents:
Hegrippedthebroom,He gripped
the broom tightly with both his hands and knees.

title: He'dneverfeltanything
contents:
He'dneverfeltanything,He'd never felt
anything like that.

title: Itwasasthough
contents:
Itwasasthough,It was as though the broom was trying to buck him
off.

title: ButNimbusTwoThousands
contents:
ButNimbusTwoThousands,But Nimbus Two Thousands did not suddenly decide to buck their
riders off.

title: Harrytriedtoturn
contents:
Harrytriedtoturn,Harry tried to turn back toward the Gryffindor goal- posts
-- he had half a mind to ask Wood to call time-out -- and then he
realized that his broom was completely out of his control.

title: Hecouldn'tdirectit
contents: Hecouldn'tdirectit,He couldn't direct it at all.

title: Itwaszigzaggingthrough
contents:
Itwaszigzaggingthrough,It was zigzagging through the
air, and every now and then making violent swishing movements that
almost unseated him.

title: "Slytherininpossession--
contents:
"Slytherininpossession--,"Slytherin in possession -- Flint with the Quaffle -- passes Spinnet --
passes Bell -- hit hard in the face by a Bludger, hope it broke his nose
-- only joking, Professor -- Slytherins score -- A no...

title: Nooneseemedto
contents:
Nooneseemedto,No one seemed to have noticed that Harry's
broom was behaving strangely.

title: Itwascarrying-him
contents:
Itwascarrying-him,It was carrying- him slowly higher, away
from the game, jerking and twitching as it went.

title: "DunnowhatHarrythinks
contents: "DunnowhatHarrythinks,"Dunno what Harry thinks he's doing," Hagrid mumbled.

title: "IfIdidn'know
contents:
"IfIdidn'know,"If I didn' know better, I'd say he'd lost control of
his broom...

title: buthecan'thave...."
contents:
buthecan'thave....",but he can't have...."
Suddenly, people were pointing up at Harry all over the stands.

title: Hisbroomhadstarted
contents:
Hisbroomhadstarted,His
broom had started to roll over and over, with him only just managing to
hold on.

title: Harry'sbroomhadgiven
contents:
Harry'sbroomhadgiven,Harry's broom had given a wild
jerk and Harry swung off it.

title: Hewasnowdangling
contents:
Hewasnowdangling,He was now dangling from it, holding on
with only one hand.

title: 152"Didsomethinghappen
contents:
152"Didsomethinghappen,152
"Did something happen to it when Flint blocked him?" Seamus whispered.

title: "Can'thave,"Hagridsaid,
contents: "Can'thave,"Hagridsaid,,"Can't have," Hagrid said, his voice shaking.

contents:
"Can'tnothinginterferewith,"Can't nothing interfere
with a broomstick except powerful Dark magic -- no kid could do that to

At these words, Hermione seized Hagrid's binoculars, but instead of
looking up at Harry, she started looking frantically at the crowd.

title: "Whatareyoudoing?"
contents: "Whatareyoudoing?","What are you doing?" moaned Ron, gray-faced.

title: "Iknewit,"Hermione
contents:
"Iknewit,"Hermione,"I knew it," Hermione gasped, "Snape -- look."
Ron grabbed the binoculars.

title: Snapewasinthe
contents:
Snapewasinthe,Snape was in the middle of the stands
opposite them.

title: Hehadhiseyes
contents:
Hehadhiseyes,He had his eyes fixed on Harry and was muttering nonstop

title: "He'sdoingsomething--
contents: "He'sdoingsomething--,"He's doing something -- jinxing the broom," said Hermione.

title: "Whatshouldwedo?"
contents:
"Whatshouldwedo?","What should we do?"
"Leave it to me."
Before Ron could say another word, Hermione had disappeared.

title: Ronturnedthebinoculars
contents:
Ronturnedthebinoculars,Ron turned
the binoculars back on Harry.

title: Hisbroomwasvibrating
contents:
Hisbroomwasvibrating,His broom was vibrating so hard, it was

title: Thewholecrowdwas
contents:
Thewholecrowdwas,The whole crowd was on
its feet, watching, terrified, as the Weasleys flew up to try and pull

title: Theydroppedlowerand
contents:
Theydroppedlowerand,They dropped lower
and circled beneath him, obviously hoping to catch him if he fell.

title: MarcusFlintseizedthe
contents:
MarcusFlintseizedthe,Marcus
Flint seized the Quaffle and scored five times without anyone noticing.

title: "Comeon,Hermione,"Ron
contents: "Comeon,Hermione,"Ron,"Come on, Hermione," Ron muttered desperately.

title: Hermionehadfoughther
contents:

contents:
ReachingSnape,shecrouched,Reaching Snape, she crouched down, pulled out her wand, and whispered a

contents:

title: 153Ittookperhaps
contents:
153Ittookperhaps,153
It took perhaps thirty seconds for Snape to realize that he was on fire.

Upintheair,,Up in the air, Harry was suddenly able to clamber back on

title: "Neville,youcanlook!"
contents: "Neville,youcanlook!","Neville, you can look!" Ron said.

title: Nevillehadbeensobbing
contents:

contents:

contents:
"I'vegottheSnitch!","I've got the Snitch!" he shouted, waving it above his head, and the

title: "Hedidn'tcatchit,
contents:
"Hedidn'tcatchit,,"He didn't catch it, he nearly swallowed it," Flint was still howling

title: Harryheardnoneof
contents:
Harryheardnoneof,Harry
heard none of this, though.

contents:
Hewasbeingmade,He was being made a cup of strong tea back
in Hagrid's hut, with Ron and Hermione.

title: "ItwasSnape,"Ron
contents: "ItwasSnape,"Ron,"It was Snape," Ron was explaining, "Hermione and I saw him.

title: Hewascursingyour
contents:
Hewascursingyour,He was
cursing your broomstick, muttering, he wouldn't take his eyes off you."
"Rubbish," said Hagrid, who hadn't heard a word of what had gone on next
to him in the stands.

title: "WhywouldSnapedo
contents:
"WhywouldSnapedo,"Why would Snape do somethin' like that?"
Harry, Ron, and Hermione looked at one another, wondering what to tell
him.

title: "Ifoundoutsomething
contents: "Ifoundoutsomething,"I found out something about him," he told Hagrid.

title: "Hetriedtoget
contents:
"Hetriedtoget,"He tried to get past
that three-headed dog on Halloween.

title: Wethinkhewas
contents:
Wethinkhewas,We think he was trying
to steal whatever it's guarding."
Hagrid dropped the teapot.

title: "Howdoyouknow
contents: "Howdoyouknow,"How do you know about Fluffy?" he said.

title: 154"Fluffy?""Yeah--
contents:
154"Fluffy?""Yeah--,154
"Fluffy?"
"Yeah -- he's mine -- bought him off a Greek chappie I met in the pub
las' year -- I lent him to Dumbledore to guard the
"Yes?" said Harry eagerly.

title: "Now,don'taskme
contents: "Now,don'taskme,"Now, don't ask me anymore," said Hagrid gruffly.

title: "That'stopsecret,that
contents:
"That'stopsecret,that,"That's top secret,
that is."
"But Snape's trying to steal it."
"Rubbish," said Hagrid again.

title: "Snape'saHogwartsteacher,
contents:
"Snape'saHogwartsteacher,,"Snape's a Hogwarts teacher, he'd do
nothin' of the sort."
"So why did he just try and kill Harry?" cried Hermione.

title: Theafternoon'seventscertainly
contents:
Theafternoon'seventscertainly,The afternoon's events certainly seemed to have changed her mind about
