title: Iknowajinx
contents:
Iknowajinx,I know a jinx when I see one, Hagrid, I've read all about them!
You've got to keep eye contact, and Snape wasn't blinking at all, I saw
him!"
"I'm tellin' yeh, yer wrong!" said Hagrid hotly.

title: "Idon'knowwhy
contents:
"Idon'knowwhy,"I don' know why
Harry's broom acted like that, but Snape wouldn' try an' kill a student!
Now, listen to me, all three of yeh -- yer meddlin' in things that don'
concern yeh.

title: Youforgetthatdog,
contents:
Youforgetthatdog,,You forget that dog, an' you forget what
it's guardin', that's between Professor Dumbledore an' Nicolas Flamel
--"
"Aha!" said Harry, "so there's someone called Nicolas Flamel involved,
is there?"
Hagrid looked furious with himself.

title: CHAPTERTWELVETHEMIRROR
contents:
CHAPTERTWELVETHEMIRROR,CHAPTER TWELVE
THE MIRROR OF ERISED
Christmas was coming.

title: Onemorninginmid-December,
contents:
Onemorninginmid-December,,One morning in mid-December, Hogwarts woke to find
155
itself covered in several feet of snow.

title: Thelakefrozesolid
contents:
Thelakefrozesolid,The lake froze solid and the
Weasley twins were punished for bewitching several snowballs so that
they followed Quirrell around, bouncing off the back of his turban.

title: Thefewowlsthat
contents:
Thefewowlsthat,The
few owls that managed to battle their way through the stormy sky to
deliver mail had to be nursed back to health by Hagrid before they could
fly off again.

title: Noonecouldwait
contents: Noonecouldwait,No one could wait for the holidays to start.

title: WhiletheGryffindorcommon
contents:
WhiletheGryffindorcommon,While the Gryffindor common
room and the Great Hall had roaring fires, the drafty corridors had
become icy and a bitter wind rattled the windows in the classrooms.

title: Worstofallwere
contents:
Worstofallwere,Worst of all were Professor Snape's classes down in the dungeons, where
their breath rose in a mist before them and they kept as close as
possible to their hot cauldrons.

title: "Idofeelso
contents:
"Idofeelso,"I do feel so sorry," said Draco Malfoy, one Potions class, "for all
those people who have to stay at Hogwarts for Christmas because they're
not wanted at home."
He was looking over at Harry as he spoke.

title: Harry,whowasmeasuring
contents: Harry,whowasmeasuring,Harry, who was measuring out powdered spine of lionfish, ignored them.

title: Malfoyhadbeeneven
contents:
Malfoyhadbeeneven,Malfoy had been even more unpleasant than usual since the Quidditch
match.

title: DisgustedthattheSlytherins
contents:
DisgustedthattheSlytherins,Disgusted that the Slytherins had lost, he had tried to get
everyone laughing at how a wide-mouthed tree frog would be replacing
Harry as Seeker next.

title: Thenhe'drealizedthat
contents:
Thenhe'drealizedthat,Then he'd realized that nobody found this funny,
because they were all so impressed at the way Harry had managed to stay
on his bucking broomstick.

title: SoMalfoy,jealousand
contents:
SoMalfoy,jealousand,So Malfoy, jealous and angry, had gone back
to taunting Harry about having no proper family.

title: Itwastruethat
contents: Itwastruethat,It was true that Harry wasn't going back to Privet Drive for Christmas.

title: ProfessorMcGonagallhadcome
contents:
ProfessorMcGonagallhadcome,Professor McGonagall had come around the week before, making a list of
students who would be staying for the holidays, and Harry had signed up
at once.

title: Hedidn'tfeelsorry
contents:
Hedidn'tfeelsorry,He didn't feel sorry for himself at all; this would probably be
the best Christmas he'd ever had.

title: Ronandhisbrothers
contents:
Ronandhisbrothers,Ron and his brothers were staying,
too, because Mr.

title: Weasleyweregoingto
contents:
Weasleyweregoingto,Weasley were going to Romania to visit
Charlie.

title: Whentheyleftthe
contents:
Whentheyleftthe,When they left the dungeons at the end of Potions, they found a large
fir tree blocking the corridor ahead.

title: Twoenormousfeetsticking
contents:
Twoenormousfeetsticking,Two enormous feet sticking out at
the bottom and a loud puffing sound told them that Hagrid was behind it.

title: "Hi,Hagrid,wantany
contents:
"Hi,Hagrid,wantany,"Hi, Hagrid, want any help?" Ron asked, sticking his head through the
branches.

title: 156"Nah,I'mall
contents:
156"Nah,I'mall,156
"Nah, I'm all right, thanks, Ron."
"Would you mind moving out of the way?" came Malfoys cold drawl from
behind them.

title: "Areyoutryingto
contents:
"Areyoutryingto,"Are you trying to earn some extra money, Weasley? Hoping
to be gamekeeper yourself when you leave Hogwarts, I suppose -- that hut
of Hagrid's must seem like a palace compared to what your family's used
to."
Ron dived at Malfoy just as Snape came up the stairs.

title: "WEASLEY!"Ronletgo
contents:
"WEASLEY!"Ronletgo,"WEASLEY!"
Ron let go of the front of Malfoy's robes.

title: "Hewasprovoked,Professor
contents:
"Hewasprovoked,Professor,"He was provoked, Professor Snape," said Hagrid, sticking his huge hairy
face out from behind the tree.

title: "Malfoywasinsultin'his
contents:
"Malfoywasinsultin'his,"Malfoy was insultin' his family."
"Be that as it may, fighting is against Hogwarts rules, Hagrid," said
Snape silkily.

title: "FivepointsfromGryffindor,
contents:
"FivepointsfromGryffindor,,"Five points from Gryffindor, Weasley, and be grateful it
isn't more.

title: Movealong,allof
contents:
Movealong,allof,Move along, all of you."
Malfoy, Crabbe, and Goyle pushed roughly past the tree, scattering
needles everywhere and smirking.

title: "I'llgethim,"said
contents:
"I'llgethim,"said,"I'll get him," said Ron, grinding his teeth at Malfoy's back, "one of
these days, I'll get him --"
"I hate them both," said Harry, "Malfoy and Snape."
"Come on, cheer up, it's nearly Christmas," said Hagrid.

title: "Tellyehwhat,come
contents:
"Tellyehwhat,come,"Tell yeh what,
come with me an' see the Great Hall, looks a treat."
So the three of them followed Hagrid and his tree off to -the Great
Hall, where Professor McGonagall and Professor Flitwick were busy with
the Christmas decorations.

title: "Ah,Hagrid,thelast
contents:
"Ah,Hagrid,thelast,"Ah, Hagrid, the last tree -- put it in the far corner, would you?"
The hall looked spectacular.

title: Festoonsofhollyand
contents:
Festoonsofhollyand,Festoons of holly and mistletoe hung all
around the walls, and no less than twelve towering Christmas trees stood
around the room, some sparkling with tiny icicles, some glittering with
hundreds of candles.

title: 157"Howmanydays
contents:
157"Howmanydays,157
"How many days you got left until yer holidays?" Hagrid asked.

title: "Andthatremindsme
contents:
"Andthatremindsme,"And that reminds me -Harry, Ron, we've got
half an hour before lunch, we should be in the library."
"Oh yeah, you're right," said Ron, tearing his eyes away from Professor
Flitwick, who had golden bubbles blossoming out of his wand and was
trailing them over the branches of the new tree.

title: "Thelibrary?"saidHagrid,
contents: "Thelibrary?"saidHagrid,,"The library?" said Hagrid, following them out of the hall.

title: "Justbeforetheholidays?
contents:
"Justbeforetheholidays?,"Just before
the holidays? Bit keen, aren't yeh?"
"Oh, we're not working," Harry told him brightly.

title: "Eversinceyoumentioned
contents:
"Eversinceyoumentioned,"Ever since you
mentioned Nicolas Flamel we've been trying to find out who he is."
"You what?" Hagrid looked shocked.

title: "Listenhere--I've
contents:
"Listenhere--I've,"Listen here -- I've told yeh -- drop
it.

title: It'snothin'toyou
contents:
It'snothin'toyou,It's nothin' to you what that dog's guardin'."
"We just want to know who Nicolas Flamel is, that's all," said Hermione.

title: "Unlessyou'dliketo
contents: "Unlessyou'dliketo,"Unless you'd like to tell us and save us the trouble?" Harry added.

title: "Wemust'vebeenthrough
contents:
"Wemust'vebeenthrough,"We
must've been through hundreds of books already and we can't find him
anywhere -- just give us a hint -- I know I've read his name somewhere."
"I'm sayin' nothin, said Hagrid flatly.

title: "Justhavetofind
contents:
"Justhavetofind,"Just have to find out for ourselves, then," said Ron, and they left
Hagrid looking disgruntled and hurried off to the library.

title: Theyhadindeedbeen
contents:
Theyhadindeedbeen,They had indeed been searching books for Flamel's name ever since Hagrid
had let it slip, because how else were they going to find out what Snape
was trying to steal? The trouble was, it was very hard to know where to
begin, not knowing what Flamel might have done to get himself into a
book.

title: Hewasn'tinGreat
contents:
Hewasn'tinGreat,He wasn't in Great Wizards of the Twentieth Century, or Notable
Magical Names of Our Time; he was missing, too, from Important Modern
Magical Discoveries, and A Study of Recent Developments in Wizardry.

title: Andthen,ofcourse,
contents:
Andthen,ofcourse,,And
then, of course, there was the sheer size of the library; tens of
thousands of books; thousands of shelves; hundreds of narrow rows.

title: Hermionetookouta
contents:
Hermionetookouta,Hermione took out a list of subjects and titles she had decided to
search while Ron strode off down a row of books and started pulling them
off the shelves at random.

title: Harrywanderedoverto
contents:
Harrywanderedoverto,Harry wandered over to the Restricted
Section.

title: Hehadbeenwondering
contents:
Hehadbeenwondering,He had been wondering for a while if Flamel wasn't somewhere in
158
there.

title: Unfortunately,youneededa
contents:
Unfortunately,youneededa,Unfortunately, you needed a specially signed note from one of the
teachers to look in any of the restricted books, and he knew he'd never
get one.

title: Thesewerethebooks
contents:
Thesewerethebooks,These were the books containing powerful Dark Magic never
taught at Hogwarts, and only read by older students studying advanced
Defense Against the Dark Arts.

title: "Whatareyoulooking
contents:
"Whatareyoulooking,"What are you looking for, boy?"
"Nothing," said Harry.

title: MadamPincethelibrarian
contents: MadamPincethelibrarian,Madam Pince the librarian brandished a feather duster at him.

title: Goon--out!"
contents:
Goon--out!",Go on -- out!"
Wishing he'd been a bit quicker at thinking up some story, Harry left
the library.

title: He,Ron,andHermione
contents:
He,Ron,andHermione,He, Ron, and Hermione had already agreed they'd better not
ask Madam Pince where they could find Flamel.

title: Theyweresureshe'd
contents:
Theyweresureshe'd,They were sure she'd be
able to tell them, but they couldn't risk Snape hearing what they were
up to.

title: Harrywaitedoutsidein
contents:
Harrywaitedoutsidein,Harry waited outside in the corridor to see if the other two had found
anything, but he wasn't very hopeful.

title: Theyhadbeenlooking
contents:
Theyhadbeenlooking,They had been looking for two
weeks, after A, but as they only had odd moments between lessons it
wasn't surprising they'd found nothing.

title: Whattheyreallyneeded
contents:
Whattheyreallyneeded,What they really needed was a
nice long search without Madam Pince breathing down their necks.

title: Fiveminuteslater,Ron
contents: Fiveminuteslater,Ron,Five minutes later, Ron and Hermione joined him, shaking their heads.

title: "Youwillkeeplooking
contents: "Youwillkeeplooking,"You will keep looking while I'm away, won't you?" said Hermione.

title: "Andsendmean
contents:
"Andsendmean,"And
send me an owl if you find anything."
"And you could ask your parents if they know who Flamel is," said Ron.

title: "It'dbesafeto
contents:
"It'dbesafeto,"It'd be safe to ask them."
"Very safe, as they're both dentists," said Hermione.

title: Oncetheholidayshad
contents:
Oncetheholidayshad,Once the holidays had started, Ron and Harry were having too good a time
to think much about Flamel.

title: Theyhadthedormitory
contents:
Theyhadthedormitory,They had the dormitory to themselves and the
common room was far emptier than usual, so they were able to get the
good armchairs by the fire.

title: Theysatbythe
contents:
Theysatbythe,They sat by the hour eating anything they
could spear on a toasting fork -- bread, English muffins, marshmallows
-- and plotting ways of getting Malfoy expelled, which were fun to talk
159
about even if they wouldn't work.

title: Ronalsostartedteaching
contents: Ronalsostartedteaching,Ron also started teaching Harry wizard chess.

title: Thiswasexactlylike
contents:
Thiswasexactlylike,This was exactly like
Muggle chess except that the figures were alive, which made it a lot
like directing troops in battle.

title: Ron'ssetwasvery
contents: Ron'ssetwasvery,Ron's set was very old and battered.

title: Likeeverythingelsehe
contents:
Likeeverythingelsehe,Like everything else he owned, it had once belonged to someone else in
his family -- in this case, his grandfather.

title: However,oldchessmenweren't
contents:
However,oldchessmenweren't,However, old chessmen
weren't a drawback at all.

title: Ronknewthemso
contents:
Ronknewthemso,Ron knew them so well he never had trouble
getting them to do what he wanted.

title: Harryplayedwithchessmen
contents:
Harryplayedwithchessmen,Harry played with chessmen Seamus Finnigan had lent him, and they didn't
trust him at all.

title: Hewasn'tavery
contents:
Hewasn'tavery,He wasn't a very good player yet and they kept
shouting different bits of advice at him, which was confusing.

title: "Don'tsendmethere,
contents:
"Don'tsendmethere,,"Don't
send me there, can't you see his knight? Send him, we can afford to lose
him." On Christmas Eve, Harry went to bed looking forward to the next
day for the food and the fun, but not expecting any presents at all.

title: Whenhewokeearly
contents:
Whenhewokeearly,When he woke early in the morning, however, the first thing he saw was a
small pile of packages at the foot of his bed.

title: "MerryChristmas,"saidRon
contents:
"MerryChristmas,"saidRon,"Merry Christmas," said Ron sleepily as Harry scrambled out of bed and
pulled on his bathrobe.

title: "Willyoulookat
contents:
"Willyoulookat,"Will you look at this? I've got some presents!"
"What did you expect, turnips?" said Ron, turning to his own pile, which
was a lot bigger than Harry's.

title: Harrypickedupthe
contents: Harrypickedupthe,Harry picked up the top parcel.

title: Itwaswrappedin
contents:
Itwaswrappedin,It was wrapped in thick brown paper and
scrawled across it was To Harry, from Hagrid.

title: Insidewasaroughly
contents:
Insidewasaroughly,Inside was a roughly cut
wooden flute.

title: Hagridhadobviouslywhittled
contents: Hagridhadobviouslywhittled,Hagrid had obviously whittled it himself.

title: Harryblewit--
contents:
Harryblewit--,Harry blew it --
it sounded a bit like an owl.

title: Asecond,verysmall
contents: Asecond,verysmall,A second, very small parcel contained a note.

title: Wereceivedyourmessage
contents: Wereceivedyourmessage,We received your message and enclose your Christmas present.

title: FromUncleVernonand
contents:
FromUncleVernonand,From Uncle
Vernon and Aunt Petunia.

title: Tapedtothenote
contents: Tapedtothenote,Taped to the note was a fifty-pence piece.

title: Ronwasfascinatedby
contents: Ronwasfascinatedby,Ron was fascinated by the fifty pence.

title: "Weird!"hesaid,'NMat
contents:
"Weird!"hesaid,'NMat,"Weird!" he said, 'NMat a shape! This is money?"
160
"You can keep it," said Harry, laughing at how pleased Ron was.

title: "Hagridandmyaunt
contents:
"Hagridandmyaunt,"Hagrid
and my aunt and uncle -- so who sent these?"
"I think I know who that one's from," said Ron, turning a bit pink and
pointing to a very lumpy parcel.

title: Itoldheryou
contents:
Itoldheryou,I told her you didn't expect
any presents and -- oh, no," he groaned, "she's made you a Weasley
sweater."
Harry had torn open the parcel to find a thick, hand-knitted sweater in
emerald green and a large box of homemade fudge.

title: "Everyyearshemakes
contents:
"Everyyearshemakes,"Every year she makes us a sweater," said Ron, unwrapping his own, "and
mine's always maroon."
"That's really nice of her," said Harry, trying the fudge, which was
very tasty.

title: Hisnextpresentalso
contents:
Hisnextpresentalso,His next present also contained candy -- a large box of Chocolate Frogs
from Hermione.

title: Harrypickeditup
contents: Harrypickeditup,Harry picked it up and felt it.

title: Somethingfluidandsilvery
contents:
Somethingfluidandsilvery,Something fluid and silvery gray went slithering to the floor where it
lay in gleaming folds.

title: "I'veheardofthose,"
contents:
"I'veheardofthose,","I've heard of those," he said in a hushed voice, dropping the box of
Every Flavor Beans he'd gotten from Hermione.

title: "Ifthat'swhatI
contents:
"Ifthat'swhatI,"If that's what I think it
is -- they're really rare, and really valuable."
"What is it?"
Harry picked the shining, silvery cloth off the floor.

title: Itwasstrangeto
contents:
Itwasstrangeto,It was strange to
the touch, like water woven into material.

title: "It'saninvisibilitycloak,"
contents: "It'saninvisibilitycloak,","It's an invisibility cloak," said Ron, a look of awe on his face.

title: "I'msureitis
contents:
"I'msureitis,"I'm
sure it is -- try it on."
Harry threw the cloak around his shoulders and Ron gave a yell.

title: "Itis!Lookdown!"
contents:
"Itis!Lookdown!","It is! Look down!"
Harry looked down at his feet, but they were gone.

title: Hedashedtothe
contents:
Hedashedtothe,He dashed to the
161
mirror.

title: Sureenough,hisreflection
contents:
Sureenough,hisreflection,Sure enough, his reflection looked back at him, just his head
suspended in midair, his body completely invisible.

title: Hepulledthecloak
contents:
Hepulledthecloak,He pulled the cloak
over his head and his reflection vanished completely.

title: "There'sanote!"said
contents: "There'sanote!"said,"There's a note!" said Ron suddenly.

title: "Anotefellout
contents:
"Anotefellout,"A note fell out of it!"
Harry pulled off the cloak and seized the letter.

title: Writteninnarrow,loopy
contents:
Writteninnarrow,loopy,Written in narrow,
loopy writing he had never seen before were the following words: Your
father left this in my possession before he died.

title: Itistimeit
contents:
Itistimeit,It is time it was
returned to you.

title: AVeryMerryChristmas
contents: AVeryMerryChristmas,A Very Merry Christmas to you.

title: "I'dgiveanythingfor
contents: "I'dgiveanythingfor,"I'd give anything for one of these," he said.

title: What'sthematter?""Nothing,"
contents:
What'sthematter?""Nothing,",What's the
matter?"
"Nothing," said Harry.

title: Whohadsentthe
contents:
Whohadsentthe,Who had sent the cloak? Had
it really once belonged to his father?
Before he could say or think anything else, the dormitory door was flung
open and Fred and George Weasley bounded in.

title: Harrystuffedthecloak
contents:
Harrystuffedthecloak,Harry stuffed the cloak
quickly out of sight.

title: Hedidn'tfeellike
contents:
Hedidn'tfeellike,He didn't feel like sharing it with anyone else
yet.

title: "MerryChristmas!""Hey,look
contents:
"MerryChristmas!""Hey,look,"Merry Christmas!"
"Hey, look -- Harry's got a Weasley sweater, too!"
Fred and George were wearing blue sweaters, one with a large yellow F on
it, the other a G.

title: "Harry'sisbetterthan
contents:
"Harry'sisbetterthan,"Harry's is better than ours, though," said Fred, holding up Harry's
sweater.

title: "Sheobviouslymakesmore
contents:
"Sheobviouslymakesmore,"She obviously makes more of an effort if you're not family."
"Why aren't you wearing yours, Ron?" George demanded.

title: "Comeon,getit
contents:
"Comeon,getit,"Come on, get it
on, they're lovely and warm."
"I hate maroon," Ron moaned halfheartedly as he pulled it over his head.

title: 162"Youhaven'tgot
contents:
162"Youhaven'tgot,162
"You haven't got a letter on yours," George observed.

title: "Isupposeshethinks
contents:
"Isupposeshethinks,"I suppose she
thinks you don't forget your name.

title: Butwe'renotstupid
contents:
Butwe'renotstupid,But we're not stupid -- we know we're
called Gred and Forge."
"What's all th is noise.

title: PercyWeasleystuckhis
contents: PercyWeasleystuckhis,Percy Weasley stuck his head through the door, looking disapproving.

title: Hehadclearlygotten
contents:
Hehadclearlygotten,He
had clearly gotten halfway through unwrapping his presents as he, too,
carried a lumpy sweater over his arm, which
Fred seized.

title: "Pforprefect!Get
contents:
"Pforprefect!Get,"P for prefect! Get it on, Percy, come on, we're all wearing ours, even
Harry got one."
"I -- don't -- want said Percy thickly, as the twins forced the sweater
over his head, knocking his glasses askew.

title: "Andyou'renotsitting
contents:
"Andyou'renotsitting,"And you're not sitting with the prefects today, either," said
George.

title: "Christmasisatime
contents:
"Christmasisatime,"Christmas is a time for family."
They frog-marched Percy from the room, his arms pinned to his side by
his sweater.

title: Harryhadneverin
contents: Harryhadneverin,Harry had never in all his life had such a Christmas dinner.

title: Ahundredfat,roast
contents:
Ahundredfat,roast,A hundred
fat, roast turkeys; mountains of roast and boiled potatoes; platters of
chipolatas; tureens of buttered peas, silver boats of thick, rich gravy
and cranberry sauce -- and stacks of wizard crackers every few feet
along the table.

title: Thesefantasticpartyfavors
contents:
Thesefantasticpartyfavors,These fantastic party favors were nothing like the
feeble Muggle ones the Dursleys usually bought, with their little
plastic toys and their flimsy paper hats inside.

title: Harrypulledawizard
contents:
Harrypulledawizard,Harry pulled a wizard
cracker with Fred and it didn't just bang, it went off with a blast like
a cannon and engulfed them all in a cloud of blue smoke, while from the
inside exploded a rear admiral's hat and several live, white mice.

title: UpattheHigh
contents:
UpattheHigh,Up at
the High Table, Dumbledore had swapped his pointed wizard's hat for a
flowered bonnet, and was chuckling merrily at a joke Professor Flitwick
had just read him.

title: FlamingChristmaspuddingsfollowed
contents: FlamingChristmaspuddingsfollowed,Flaming Christmas puddings followed the turkey.

title: Percynearlybrokehis
contents:
Percynearlybrokehis,Percy nearly broke his
teeth on a silver sickle embedded in his slice.

title: HarrywatchedHagridgetting
contents:
HarrywatchedHagridgetting,Harry watched Hagrid
getting redder and redder in the face as he called for more wine,
finally kissing Professor McGonagall on the cheek, who, to Harry's
163
amazement, giggled and blushed, her top hat lopsided.

title: WhenHarryfinallyleft
contents:
WhenHarryfinallyleft,When Harry finally left the table, he was laden down with a stack of
things out of the crackers, including a pack of nonexplodable, luminous
balloons, a Grow-Your-Own-Warts kit, and his own new wizard chess set.

title: Thewhitemicehad
contents:
Thewhitemicehad,The white mice had disappeared and Harry had a nasty feeling they were
going to end up as Mrs.

title: HarryandtheWeasleys
contents:
HarryandtheWeasleys,Harry and the Weasleys spent a happy afternoon having a furious snowball
fight on the grounds.

title: Then,cold,wet,and
contents:
Then,cold,wet,and,Then, cold, wet, and gasping for breath, they
returned to the fire in the Gryffindor common room, where Harry broke in
his new chess set by losing spectacularly to Ron.

title: Hesuspectedhewouldn't
contents:
Hesuspectedhewouldn't,He suspected he
wouldn't have lost so badly if Percy hadn't tried to help him so much.

title: Afteramealof
contents:
Afteramealof,After a meal of turkey sandwiches, crumpets, trifle, and Christmas cake,
everyone felt too full and sleepy to do much before bed except sit and
watch Percy chase Fred and George all over Gryffindor tower because
they'd stolen his prefect badge.

title: IthadbeenHarry's
contents: IthadbeenHarry's,It had been Harry's best Christmas day ever.

title: Yetsomethinghadbeen
contents:
Yetsomethinghadbeen,Yet something had been
nagging at the back of his mind all day.

title: Notuntilheclimbed
contents:
Notuntilheclimbed,Not until he climbed into bed
was he free to think about it: the invisibility cloak and whoever had
sent it.

title: Ron,fullofturkey
contents:
Ron,fullofturkey,Ron, full of turkey and cake and with nothing mysterious to bother him,
fell asleep almost as soon as he'd drawn the curtains of his
four-poster.

title: Harryleanedoverthe
contents:
Harryleanedoverthe,Harry leaned over the side of his own bed and pulled the
cloak out from under it.

title: Heletthematerial
contents:
Heletthematerial,He let the material flow
over his hands, smoother than silk, light as air.

title: Useitwell,the
contents:
Useitwell,the,Use it well, the note
had said.

title: Hehadtotry
contents: Hehadtotry,He had to try it, now.

title: Heslippedoutof
contents:
Heslippedoutof,He slipped out of bed and wrapped the cloak
around himself.

title: Lookingdownathis
contents:
Lookingdownathis,Looking down at his legs, he saw only moonlight and
shadows.

title: Itwasavery
contents: Itwasavery,It was a very funny feeling.

title: ThewholeofHogwarts
contents:
ThewholeofHogwarts,The whole of Hogwarts was open to him
in this cloak.

title: Excitementfloodedthroughhim
contents:
Excitementfloodedthroughhim,Excitement flooded through him as he stood there in the
dark and silence.

title: Hecouldgoanywhere
contents:
Hecouldgoanywhere,He could go anywhere in this, anywhere, and Filch
would never know.

title: 164Rongruntedin
contents:
164Rongruntedin,164
Ron grunted in his sleep.

title: ShouldHarrywakehim?
contents:
ShouldHarrywakehim?,Should Harry wake him? Something held him back
-- his father's cloak -- he felt that this time -- the first time -- he
wanted to use it alone.

title: Hecreptoutof
contents:
Hecreptoutof,He crept out of the dormitory, down the stairs, across the common room,
and climbed through the portrait hole.

title: "Who'sthere?"squawkedthe
contents: "Who'sthere?"squawkedthe,"Who's there?" squawked the Fat Lady.

title: Hewalkedquicklydown
contents:
Hewalkedquicklydown,He walked
quickly down the corridor.

title: Whereshouldhego?
contents: Whereshouldhego?,Where should he go? He stopped, his heart racing, and thought.

title: Andthenitcame
contents:
Andthenitcame,And then
it came to him.

title: TheRestrictedSectionin
contents: TheRestrictedSectionin,The Restricted Section in the library.

title: He'dbeableto
contents:
He'dbeableto,He'd be able to
read as long as he liked, as long as it took to find out who Flamel was.

title: Hesetoff,drawing
contents:
Hesetoff,drawing,He set off, drawing the invisibility cloak tight around him as he
walked.

title: Thelibrarywaspitch-black
contents: Thelibrarywaspitch-black,The library was pitch-black and very eerie.

title: Harrylitalamp
contents:
Harrylitalamp,Harry lit a lamp to see his
way along the rows of books.

title: Thelamplookedas
contents:
Thelamplookedas,The lamp looked as if it was floating along
in midair, and even though Harry could feel his arm supporting it, the
sight gave him the creeps.

title: TheRestrictedSectionwas
contents: TheRestrictedSectionwas,The Restricted Section was right at the back of the library.

title: Steppingcarefullyover
contents:
Steppingcarefullyover,Step ping
carefully over the rope that separated these books from the rest of the
library, he held up his lamp to read the titles.

title: Theirpeeling,fadedgold
contents:
Theirpeeling,fadedgold,Their peeling, faded gold letters spelled
words in languages Harry couldn't understand.

title: Somehadnotitle
contents: Somehadnotitle,Some had no title at all.

title: Onebookhada
contents: Onebookhada,One book had a dark stain on it that looked horribly like blood.

title: Thehairsonthe
contents:
Thehairsonthe,The
hairs on the back of Harry's neck prickled.

title: Maybehewasimagining
contents:
Maybehewasimagining,Maybe he was imagining it,
maybe not, but he thought a faint whispering was coming from the books,
as though they knew someone was there who shouldn't be.

title: Settingthelampdown
contents:
Settingthelampdown,Setting the lamp down carefully on the floor,
he looked along the bottom shelf for an interestinglooking book.

title: Alargeblackand
contents:
Alargeblackand,A large
black and silver volume caught his eye.

title: Hepulleditout
contents:
Hepulleditout,He pulled it out with
difficulty, because it was very heavy, and, balancing it on his knee,
let it fall open.

title: Apiercing,bloodcurdlingshriek
contents:
Apiercing,bloodcurdlingshriek,A piercing, bloodcurdling shriek split the silence -- the book was
screaming! Harry snapped it shut, but the shriek went on and on, one
high, unbroken, earsplitting note.

title: Hestumbledbackwardand
contents:
Hestumbledbackwardand,He stumbled backward and knocked over
his lamp, which went out at once.

title: Panicking,heheardfootsteps
contents:
Panicking,heheardfootsteps,Panicking, he heard footsteps coming
165
down the corridor outside -- stuffing the shrieking book back on the
shelf, he ran for it.

title: HepassedFilchin
contents:
HepassedFilchin,He passed Filch in the doorway; Filch's pale, wild
eyes looked straight through him, and Harry slipped under Filch's
outstretched arm and streaked off up the corridor, the book's shrieks
still ringing in his ears.

title: Hecametoa
contents: Hecametoa,He came to a sudden halt in front of a tall suit of armor.

title: Hehadbeenso
contents:
Hehadbeenso,He had been
so busy getting away from the library, he hadn't paid attention to where
he was going.

title: Perhapsbecauseitwas
contents:
Perhapsbecauseitwas,Perhaps because it was dark, he didn't recognize where he
was at all.

title: Therewasasuit
contents:
Therewasasuit,There was a suit of armor near the kitchens, he knew, but he
must be five floors above there.

title: "Youaskedmeto
contents:
"Youaskedmeto,"You asked me to come directly to you, Professor, if anyone was
wandering around at night, and somebody's been in the library Restricted
Section."
Harry felt the blood drain out of his face.

title: Whereverhewas,Filch
contents:
Whereverhewas,Filch,Wherever he was, Filch must
know a shortcut, because his soft, greasy voice was getting nearer, and
to his horror, it was Snape who replied, "The Restricted Section? Well,
they can't be far, we'll catch them."
Harry stood rooted to the spot as Filch and Snape came around the corner
ahead.

title: Theycouldn'tseehim,
contents:
Theycouldn'tseehim,,They couldn't see him, of course, but it was a narrow corridor
and if they came much nearer they'd knock right into him -- the cloak
didn't stop him from being solid.

title: Hebackedawayas
contents: Hebackedawayas,He backed away as quietly as he could.

title: Adoorstoodajar
contents: Adoorstoodajar,A door stood ajar to his left.

title: Hesqueezedthroughit,
contents:
Hesqueezedthroughit,,He squeezed through it, holding his breath, trying
not to move it, and to his relief he managed to get inside the room
without their noticing anything.

title: Theywalkedstraightpast,
contents:
Theywalkedstraightpast,,They walked straight past, and Harry
leaned against the wall, breathing deeply, listening to their footsteps
dying away.

title: Thathadbeenclose,
contents: Thathadbeenclose,,That had been close, very close.

title: Itwasafew
contents:
Itwasafew,It was a few seconds before
he noticed anything about the room he had hidden in.

title: Itlookedlikean
contents: Itlookedlikean,It looked like an unused classroom.

title: Thedarkshapesof
contents:
Thedarkshapesof,The dark shapes of desks and chairs
were piled against the walls, and there was an upturned wastepaper
basket -- but propped against the wall facing him was something that
didn't look as if it belonged there, something that looked as if someone
had just put it there to keep it out of the way.

title: Itwasamagnificent
contents:
Itwasamagnificent,It was a magnificent mirror, as high as the ceiling, with an ornate gold
frame, standing on two clawed feet.

title: Therewasaninscription
contents:
Therewasaninscription,There was an inscription carved
around the top: Erised stra ehru oyt ube cafru oyt on wohsi.

title: Hispanic166fading
contents:
Hispanic166fading,His panic
166
fading now that there was no sound of Filch and Snape, Harry moved
nearer to the mirror, wanting to look at himself but see no reflection
again.

title: Hesteppedinfront
contents: Hesteppedinfront,He stepped in front of it.

title: Hehadtoclap
contents: Hehadtoclap,He had to clap his hands to his mouth to stop himself from screaming.

title: Hisheartwaspounding
contents:
Hisheartwaspounding,His heart was pounding far more furiously than when the
book had screamed -- for he had seen not only himself in the mirror, but
a whole crowd of people standing right behind him.

title: Breathingveryfast,he
contents:
Breathingveryfast,he,Breathing very fast, he turned slowly back to
the mirror.

title: Therehewas,reflected
contents:
Therehewas,reflected,There he was, reflected in it, white and scared-looking, and there,
reflected behind him, were at least ten others.

title: Harrylookedoverhis
contents:
Harrylookedoverhis,Harry looked over his
shoulder -- but still, no one was there.

title: Orweretheyall
contents:
Orweretheyall,Or were they all invisible,
too? Was he in fact in a room full of invisible people and this mirror's
trick was that it reflected them, invisible or not?
He looked in the mirror again.

title: Awomanstandingright
contents:
Awomanstandingright,A woman standing right behind his
reflection was smiling at him and waving.

title: Hereachedouta
contents:
Hereachedouta,He reached out a hand and felt
the air behind him.

title: Ifshewasreally
contents:
Ifshewasreally,If she was really there, he'd touch her, their
reflections were so close together, but he felt only air -- she and the
others existed only in the mirror.

title: Shewasavery
contents: Shewasavery,She was a very pretty woman.

title: Shehaddarkred
contents:
Shehaddarkred,She had dark red hair and her eyes -- her
eyes are just like mine, Harry thought, edging a little closer to the
glass.

title: Brightgreen--exactly
contents:
Brightgreen--exactly,Bright green -- exactly the same shape, but then he noticed that
she was crying; smiling, but crying at the same time.

title: Thetall,thin,black-haired
contents:
Thetall,thin,black-haired,The tall, thin,
black-haired man standing next to her put his arm around her.

title: Heworeglasses,and
contents:
Heworeglasses,and,He wore
glasses, and his hair was very untidy.

title: Itstuckupat
contents:
Itstuckupat,It stuck up at the back, just as
Harry's did.

title: Harrywassoclose
contents:
Harrywassoclose,Harry was so close to the mirror now that his nose was nearly touching
that of his reflection.

title: "Dad?"Theyjustlooked
contents:
"Dad?"Theyjustlooked,"Dad?"
They just looked at him, smiling.

title: Andslowly,Harrylooked
contents:
Andslowly,Harrylooked,And slowly, Harry looked into the
faces of the other people in the mirror, and saw other pairs of green
eyes like his, other noses like his, even a little old man who looked as
though he had Harry's knobbly knees -- Harry was looking at his family,
for the first time in his life.

title: 167ThePotterssmiled
contents:
167ThePotterssmiled,167
The Potters smiled and waved at Harry and he stared hungrily back at
them, his hands pressed flat against the glass as though he was hoping
to fall right through it and reach them.

title: Hehadapowerful
contents:
Hehadapowerful,He had a powerful kind of ache
inside him, half joy, half terrible sadness.

title: Howlonghestood
contents: Howlonghestood,How long he stood there, he didn't know.

title: Thereflectionsdidnot
contents:
Thereflectionsdidnot,The reflections did not fade
and he looked and looked until a distant noise brought him back to his
senses.

title: Hecouldn'tstayhere,
contents: Hecouldn'tstayhere,,He couldn't stay here, he had to find his way back to bed.

title: Hetorehiseyes
contents:
Hetorehiseyes,He
tore his eyes away from his mother's face, whispered, "I'll come back,"
and hurried from the room.

title: "Youcouldhavewoken
contents: "Youcouldhavewoken,"You could have woken me up," said Ron, crossly.

title: "Youcancometonight,
contents: "Youcancometonight,,"You can come tonight, I'm going back, I want to show you the mirror.

title: "I'dliketosee
contents: "I'dliketosee,"I'd like to see your mom and dad," Ron said eagerly.

title: "AndIwantto
contents:
"AndIwantto,"And I want to see all your family, all the Weasleys, you'll be able to
show me your other brothers and everyone."
"You can see them any old time," said Ron.

title: "Justcomeroundmy
contents:
"Justcomeroundmy,"Just come round my house
this summer.

title: Anyway,maybeitonly
contents: Anyway,maybeitonly,Anyway, maybe it only shows dead people.

title: Shameaboutnotfinding
contents:
Shameaboutnotfinding,Shame about not
finding Flamel, though.

title: Havesomebaconor
contents:
Havesomebaconor,Have some bacon or something, why aren't you
eating anything?"
Harry couldn't eat.

title: Hehadseenhis
contents:
Hehadseenhis,He had seen his parents and would be seeing them
again tonight.

title: Hehadalmostforgotten
contents: Hehadalmostforgotten,He had almost forgotten about Flamel.

title: Itdidn'tseemvery
contents:
Itdidn'tseemvery,It didn't seem very
important anymore.

title: Whocaredwhatthe
contents:
Whocaredwhatthe,Who cared what the three headed dog was guarding?
What did it matter if Snape stole it, really?
"Are you all right?" said Ron.

title: "Youlookodd."What
contents:
"Youlookodd."What,"You look odd."
What Harry feared most was that he might not be able to find the mirror
room again.

title: WithRoncoveredin
contents:
WithRoncoveredin,With Ron covered in the cloak, too, they had to walk much
more slowly the next night.

title: TheytriedretracingHarry's
contents:
TheytriedretracingHarry's,They tried retracing Harry's route from the
library, wandering around the dark passageways for nearly an hour.

title: "Let'sforgetitand
contents:
"Let'sforgetitand,"Let's forget it and go back."
"No!" Harry hissed.

title: Iknowit'shere
contents:
Iknowit'shere,I know it's here somewhere."
They passed the ghost of a tall witch gliding in the opposite direction,
but saw no one else.

title: justasRonstarted
contents:
justasRonstarted,just as Ron started moaning that his feet were dead
168
with cold, Harry spotted the suit of armor.

title: "It'shere--just
contents:
"It'shere--just,"It's here -- just here -- yes!"
They pushed the door open.

title: Harrydroppedthecloak
contents:
Harrydroppedthecloak,Harry dropped the cloak from around his
shoulders and ran to the mirror.

title: Hismotherandfather
contents: Hismotherandfather,His mother and father beamed at the sight of him.

title: "Ican'tseeanything."
contents:
"Ican'tseeanything.","I can't see anything."
"Look! Look at them all...

title: thereareloadsof
contents:
thereareloadsof,there are loads of them...."
"I can only see you."
"Look in it properly, go on, stand where I am."
Harry stepped aside, but with Ron in front of the mirror, he couldn't
see his family anymore, just Ron in his paisley pajamas.

title: Ron,though,wasstaring
contents: Ron,though,wasstaring,Ron, though, was staring transfixed at his image.

title: "Canyouseeall
contents:
"Canyouseeall,"Can you see all your family standing around you?"
"No -- I'm alone -- but I'm different -- I look older -- and I'm head
boy!"
"What?"
"I am -- I'm wearing the badge like Bill used to -- and I'm holding the
house cup and the Quidditch cup -- I'm Quidditch captain, too.

title: Rontorehiseyes
contents:
Rontorehiseyes,Ron tore his eyes away from this splendid sight to look excitedly at
Harry.

title: "Doyouthinkthis
contents:
"Doyouthinkthis,"Do you think this mirror shows the future?"
"How can it? All my family are dead -- let me have another look --"
169
"You had it to yourself all last night, give me a bit more time."
"You're only holding the Quidditch cup, what's interesting about that? I
want to see my parents."
"Don't push me --"
A sudden noise outside in the corridor put an end to their discussion.

title: Theyhadn'trealizedhow
contents: Theyhadn'trealizedhow,They hadn't realized how loudly they had been talking.

title: "Quick!"Ronthrewthe
contents:
"Quick!"Ronthrewthe,"Quick!"
Ron threw the cloak back over them as the luminous eyes of Mrs.

title: RonandHarrystood
contents:
RonandHarrystood,Ron and Harry stood quite still, both thinking the
same thing -- did the cloak work on cats? After what seemed an age, she
turned and left.

title: "Thisisn'tsafe--
contents: "Thisisn'tsafe--,"This isn't safe -- she might have gone for Filch, I bet she heard us.

title: Comeon."AndRon
contents:
Comeon."AndRon,Come on."
And Ron pulled Harry out of the room.

title: Thesnowstillhadn't
contents: Thesnowstillhadn't,The snow still hadn't melted the next morning.

title: "Wanttoplaychess,
contents: "Wanttoplaychess,,"Want to play chess, Harry?" said Ron.

title: "No.""Whydon'twe
contents:
"No.""Whydon'twe,"No."
"Why don't we go down and visit Hagrid?"
"No...

title: yougo...""Iknow
contents:
yougo...""Iknow,you go..."
"I know what you're thinking about, Harry, that mirror.

title: Don'tgobacktonight."
contents:
Don'tgobacktonight.",Don't go back
tonight."
"Why not?"
"I dunno, I've just got a bad feeling about it -- and anyway, you've had
too many close shaves already.

title: Sowhatifthey
contents:
Sowhatifthey,So what if they can't see you? What if they walk into
you? What if you knock something over?"
"You sound like Hermione."
170
"I'm serious, Harry, don't go."
But Harry only had one thought in his head, which was to get back in
front of the mirror, and Ron wasn't going to stop him.

title: Thatthirdnighthe
contents: Thatthirdnighthe,That third night he found his way more quickly than before.

title: Hewaswalkingso
contents:
Hewaswalkingso,He was
walking so fast he knew he was making more noise than was wise, but he
didn't meet anyone.

title: Andtherewerehis
contents:
Andtherewerehis,And there were his mother and father smiling at him again, and one of
his grandfathers nodding happily.

title: Harrysankdownto
contents:
Harrysankdownto,Harry sank down to sit on the floor in
front of the mirror.

title: Therewasnothingto
contents:
Therewasnothingto,There was nothing to stop him from staying here all
night with his family.

title: Except--"So--
contents:
Except--"So--,Except --
"So -- back again, Harry?"
Harry felt as though his insides had turned to ice.

title: Sittingononeof
contents:
Sittingononeof,Sitting on one of the desks by the wall was none other than Albus
Dumbledore.

title: Harrymusthavewalked
contents:
Harrymusthavewalked,Harry must have walked straight past him, so desperate to
get to the mirror he hadn't noticed him.

title: "--Ididn't
contents:
"--Ididn't," -- I didn't see you, sir."
"Strange how nearsighted being invisible can make you," said Dumbledore,
and Harry was relieved to see that he was smiling.

title: "So,"saidDumbledore,slipping
contents:
"So,"saidDumbledore,slipping,"So," said Dumbledore, slipping off the desk to sit on the floor with
Harry, "you, like hundreds before you, have discovered the delights of
the Mirror of Erised."
"I didn't know it was called that, Sir."
"But I expect you've realized by now what it does?"
"It -- well -- it shows me my family --"
"And it showed your friend Ron himself as head boy."
"How did you know --?"
171
"I don't need a cloak to become invisible," said Dumbledore gently.

title: "Now,canyouthink
contents:
"Now,canyouthink,"Now, can you think what the Mirror of Erised shows us all?"
Harry shook his head.

title: Thehappiestmanon
contents:
Thehappiestmanon,The happiest man on earth would be able to use the
Mirror of Erised like a normal mirror, that is, he would look into it
and see himself exactly as he is.

title: Thenhesaidslowly,
contents: Thenhesaidslowly,,Then he said slowly, "It shows us what we want...

title: whateverwewant...""Yes
contents:
whateverwewant...""Yes,whatever we want..."
"Yes and no," said Dumbledore quietly.

title: "Itshowsusnothing
contents:
"Itshowsusnothing,"It shows us nothing more or less
than the deepest, most desperate desire of our hearts.

title: You,whohavenever
contents:
You,whohavenever,You, who have
never known your family, see them standing around you.

title: RonaldWeasley,whohas
contents:
RonaldWeasley,whohas,Ronald Weasley,
who has always been overshadowed by his brothers, sees himself standing
alone, the best of all of them.

title: However,thismirrorwill
contents:
However,thismirrorwill,However, this mirror will give us
neither knowledge or truth.

title: Menhavewastedaway
contents:
Menhavewastedaway,Men have wasted away before it, entranced by
what they have seen, or been driven mad, not knowing if what it shows is
real or even possible.

title: "TheMirrorwillbe
contents:
"TheMirrorwillbe,"The Mirror will be moved to a new home tomorrow, Harry, and I ask you
not to go looking for it again.

title: Ifyoueverdo
contents:
Ifyoueverdo,If you ever do run across it, you will
now be prepared.

title: Itdoesnotdo
contents:
Itdoesnotdo,It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live,
remember that.

title: Now,whydon'tyou
contents:
Now,whydon'tyou,Now, why don't you put that admirable cloak back on and
get off to bed?"
Harry stood up.

title: "Sir--ProfessorDumbledore?
contents:
"Sir--ProfessorDumbledore?,"Sir -- Professor Dumbledore? Can I ask you something?"
"Obviously, you've just done so," Dumbledore smiled.

title: "Youmayaskme
contents:
"Youmayaskme,"You may ask me one
more thing, however."
"What do you see when you look in the mirror?"
"I? I see myself holding a pair of thick, woolen socks."
Harry stared.

title: "Onecanneverhave
contents: "Onecanneverhave,"One can never have enough socks," said Dumbledore.

title: "AnotherChristmashascome
contents:
"AnotherChristmashascome,"Another Christmas
has come and gone and I didn't get a single pair.

title: Peoplewillinsiston
contents:
Peoplewillinsiston,People will insist on
giving me books."
172
It was only when he was back in bed that it struck Harry that Dumbledore
might not have been quite truthful.

title: Butthen,hethought,
contents:
Butthen,hethought,,But then, he thought, as he shoved
Scabbers off his pillow, it had been quite a personal question.

title: CHAPTERTHIRTEENNICOLASFLAMEL
contents:
CHAPTERTHIRTEENNICOLASFLAMEL,CHAPTER THIRTEEN
NICOLAS FLAMEL
Dumbledore had convinced Harry not to go looking for the Mirror of
Erised again, and for the rest of the Christmas holidays the
invisibility cloak stayed folded at the bottom of his trunk.

title: Harrywishedhecould
contents:
Harrywishedhecould,Harry
wished he could forget what he'd seen in the mirror as easily, but he
couldn't.

title: Overandoveragain
contents:
Overandoveragain,Over and over again he dreamed
about his parents disappearing in a flash of green light, while a high
voice cackled with laughter.

title: "Yousee,Dumbledorewas
contents:
"Yousee,Dumbledorewas,"You see, Dumbledore was right, that mirror could drive you mad," said
Ron, when Harry told him about these drearns.

title: Hermione,whocameback
contents:
Hermione,whocameback,Hermione, who came back the day before term started, took a different
view of things.

title: Shewastornbetween
contents:
Shewastornbetween,She was torn between horror at the idea of Harry being
out of bed, roaming the school three nights in a row ("If Filch had
caught you!"), and disappointment that he hadn't at least found out who
Nicolas Flamel was.

title: Theyhadalmostgiven
contents:
Theyhadalmostgiven,They had almost given up hope of ever finding Flamel in a li- brary
book, even though Harry was still sure he'd read the name somewhere.

title: Oncetermhadstarted,
contents:
Oncetermhadstarted,,Once term had started, they were back to skimming through books for ten
minutes during their breaks.

title: Harryhadevenless
contents:
Harryhadevenless,Harry had even less time than the other
two, because Quidditch practice had started again.

title: Woodwasworkingthe
contents: Woodwasworkingthe,Wood was working the team harder than ever.

title: Eventheendlessrain
contents:
Eventheendlessrain,Even the endless rain that
had replaced the snow couldn't dampen his spirits.

title: TheWeasleyscomplainedthat
contents:
TheWeasleyscomplainedthat,The Weasleys
complained that Wood was becoming a fanatic, but Harry was on Wood's
side.

title: Iftheywontheir
contents:
Iftheywontheir,If they won their next match, against Hufflepuff, they would
overtake Slytherin in the house championship for the first time in seven
years.

title: Quiteapartfromwanting
contents:
Quiteapartfromwanting,Quite apart from wanting to win, Harry found that he had fewer
nightmares when he was tired out after training.

title: Then,duringoneparticularly
contents:
Then,duringoneparticularly,Then, during one particularly wet and muddy practice session, Wood gave
the team a bit of bad news.

title: He'djustgottenvery
contents:
He'djustgottenvery,He'd just gotten very angry with the
173
Weasleys, who kept dive-bombing each other and pretending to fall off
their brooms.

title: "Willyoustopmessing
contents: "Willyoustopmessing,"Will you stop messing around!" he yelled.

title: "That'sexactlythesort
contents:
"That'sexactlythesort,"That's exactly the sort of
thing that'll lose us the match! Snape's refereeing this time, and he'll
be looking for any excuse to knock points off Gryffindor!"
George Weasley really did fall off his broom at these words.

title: "Snape'srefereeing?"hespluttered
contents: "Snape'srefereeing?"hespluttered,"Snape's refereeing?" he spluttered through a mouthful of mud.

title: "When'sheeverrefereed
contents:
"When'sheeverrefereed,"When's
he ever refereed a Quidditch match? He's not going to be fair if we
might overtake Slytherin."
The rest of the team landed next to George to complain, too.

title: "It'snotmyfault,"
contents: "It'snotmyfault,","It's not my fault," said Wood.

title: "We'vejustgotto
contents:
"We'vejustgotto,"We've just got to make sure we play a
clean game, so Snape hasn't got an excuse to pick on us."
Which was all very well, thought Harry, but he had another reason for
not wanting Snape near him while he was playing Quidditch....

title: Therestofthe
contents:
Therestofthe,The rest of the team hung back to talk to one another as usual at the
end of practice, but Harry headed straight back to the Gryffindor common
room, where he found Ron and Hermione playing chess.

title: Chesswastheonly
contents:
Chesswastheonly,Chess was the only
thing Hermione ever lost at, something Harry and Ron thought was very
good for her.

title: "Don'ttalktome
contents:
"Don'ttalktome,"Don't talk to me for a moment," said Ron when Harry sat down next to
him, "I need to concen --" He caught sight of Harry's face.

title: "What'sthematterwith
contents:
"What'sthematterwith,"What's the
matter with you? You look terrible."
Speaking quietly so that no one else would hear, Harry told the other
two about Snape's sudden, sinister desire to be a Quidditch referee.

title: "Don'tplay,"saidHermione
contents: "Don'tplay,"saidHermione,"Don't play," said Hermione at once.

title: "Pretendtobreakyour
contents: "Pretendtobreakyour,"Pretend to break your leg," Hermione suggested.

title: "Reallybreakyourleg,"
contents: "Reallybreakyourleg,","Really break your leg," said Ron.

title: IfIbackout,
contents:
IfIbackout,,If I back out,
174
Gryffindor can't play at all."
At that moment Neville toppled into the common room.

title: Howhehadmanaged
contents:
Howhehadmanaged,How he had managed
to climb through the portrait hole was anyone's guess, because his legs
had been stuck together with what they recognized at once as the
Leg-Locker Curse.

title: Hemusthavehad
contents:
Hemusthavehad,He must have had to bunny hop all the way up to
Gryffindor tower.

title: Everyonefelloverlaughing
contents:
Everyonefelloverlaughing,Everyone fell over laughing except Hermione, who leapt up and performed
the countercurse.

title: Neville'slegssprangapart
contents:
Neville'slegssprangapart,Neville's legs sprang apart and he got to his feet,
trembling.

title: "Whathappened?"Hermioneasked
contents:
"Whathappened?"Hermioneasked,"What happened?" Hermione asked him, leading him over to sit
with Harry and Ron.

title: "Imethimoutside
contents: "Imethimoutside,"I met him outside the library.

title: Hesaidhe'dbeen
contents:
Hesaidhe'dbeen,He said
he'd been looking for someone to practice that on."
"Go to Professor McGonagall!" Hermione urged Neville.

title: "Reporthim!"Nevilleshook
contents:
"Reporthim!"Nevilleshook,"Report him!"
Neville shook his head.

title: "Idon'twantmore
contents: "Idon'twantmore,"I don't want more trouble," he mumbled.

title: "You'vegottostand
contents: "You'vegottostand,"You've got to stand up to him, Neville!" said Ron.

title: "He'susedtowalking
contents:
"He'susedtowalking,"He's used to
walking all over people, but that's no reason to lie down in front of
him and make it easier."
"There's no need to tell me I'm not brave enough to be in Gryffindor,
Malfoy's already done that," Neville choked out.

title: Harryfeltinthe
contents:
Harryfeltinthe,Harry felt in the pocket of his robes and pulled out a Chocolate Frog,
the very last one from the box Hermione had given him for Christmas.

title: Hegaveitto
contents:
Hegaveitto,He
gave it to Neville, who looked as though he might cry.

title: "You'reworthtwelveof
contents: "You'reworthtwelveof,"You're worth twelve of Malfoy," Harry said.

title: "TheSortingHatchose
contents:
"TheSortingHatchose,"The Sorting Hat chose you
for Gryffindor, didn't it? And where's Malfoy? In stinking Slytherin."
Neville's lips twitched in a weak smile as he unwrapped the frog.

title: IthinkI'llgo
contents: IthinkI'llgo,I think I'll go to bed....

title: D'youwantthecard,
contents:
D'youwantthecard,,D'you want the card, you
collect them, don't you?"
As Neville walked away, Harry looked at the Famous Wizard card.

title: 175"Dumbledoreagain,"he
contents:
175"Dumbledoreagain,"he,175
"Dumbledore again," he said, "He was the first one I ever-"
He gasped.

title: Hestaredatthe
contents: Hestaredatthe,He stared at the back of the card.

title: Thenhelookedup
contents:
Thenhelookedup,Then he looked up at Ron
and Hermione.

title: "I'vefoundFlamel!I
contents:
"I'vefoundFlamel!I,"I've found Flamel! I told you I'd read
the name somewhere before, I read it on the train coming here -- listen
to this: 'Dumbledore is particularly famous for his defeat of the dark
wizard Grindelwald in 1945, for the discovery of the twelve uses of
dragon's blood, and his work on alchemy with his partner, Nicolas
Flamel'!"
